result.rationale:
In TopicEmbed.import the url is interpolated unescaped: `contents << "\n
\n...#{url}"`, and the resulting post is created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, while Post#cook returns `raw` unchanged for raw_html — so no Markdown/sanitization pipeline runs on it. A feed-controlled URL containing a single quote (e.g. `x' onmouseover='...`) breaks out of the attribute and injects handlers into the rendered post. Mechanism fully verifiable in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the code appends HTML containing `link: "#{url}"` without escaping `url` (only a loose `^https?://` regex check). Because imported posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly for `:raw_html`, this HTML is not passed through the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. A crafted URL containing a single quote can break out of the `href` attribute and inject additional attributes/handlers, leading to XSS when rendered (e.g. `raw post.cooked` in `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`).
